lane: datum-offset: pluvial depositional datum as a strain gauge
hypothesis: A 15 ka pluvial depositional surface is a near-level datum. Where its base-level surface is stepped or its contour deflected, a structure younger than the datum cuts it; such basin-margin structures are the class the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue is incomplete for.
mechanism: base level = smooth(min-filter(DEM, 1.7 km)); HAB = z - base; pluvial band = HAB<=120 m & slope<=6 deg & relief<=60 m; isobase = 6 km smooth of the base level over the band (absorbs rebound); flags = |resid| >= 2.5 MAD per 50 km tile and contour-azimuth kinks >= 25 deg over 300 m; each flag seeds a trace that is marched along the local structure azimuth while cross-strike relief holds (>= 33 m, the 25th percentile); dots are emitted at a 300 m hard core, >= 300 m off every mapped fault, ranked by trace relief, capped at 37,654.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Differential post-pluvial isostatic rebound itself: rebound varies between sub-basins, so a purely isostatic warp of the datum produces steps and azimuth kinks with no fault at all. Secondary mimics: alluvial-fan toes and debris-flow lobes; the 12-14 ka Truckee/Carson/Walker channel and delta margins (erosional); bedrock lithologic contacts expressed as differential erosion. The 6 km isobase is the control for the first; the relief gate and the ridge march are the controls for the others.

instrument.name: mean 300 m kernel credit per dot vs SGMC-minus-catalogue, catalogue+3px masked

holdout.evaluator: gems62.holdout.v2 (4 spatial quadrants, whole segments, 300 m buffer, parameterised truth; IR-62-HOLDOUT-02)

A_catalogue_truth.note: IR-62-HOLDOUT-02: identically 0 by arithmetic -- no dot lies within the 300 m kernel of any catalogue pixel. Bug/leakage screen only, never a quality measure.

B_sgmc_offcatalogue_truth.note: Catalogue-truth proxy. The competition target is faults ABSENT from the catalogue; they are masked out of scoring, so this number cannot measure the lane's performance on the real target. It is a leak-free lower bound on recovering a mapped-fault population.
